name: kivi-talk
description: Kivi Talk: talk out loud to the Claude Code session you are in. The voice is powered by OpenAI GPT-Live on your own OpenAI key; your session does the work with its own tools while you talk. Type /talk.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: Your own OpenAI API key (starts with sk-). Used only to open GPT-Live voice sessions, billed to your OpenAI account, about $0.05 a minute while a call is live. You can leave this empty and paste it on the call page the first time instead.

keep_transcripts.title: Keep call transcripts
keep_transcripts.description: Save what was said on each call to a file in the plugin's data folder on this computer. Off by default. Either way, when a call ends the whole conversation is handed to your Claude session so it can finish what you asked for.
